message.content:
I can see the bug clearly now. On line 5879:
```cpp
sp = &src->data[(ySrc + y) * bitmap->rowSize + xSrc];
```
It uses `bitmap->rowSize` instead of `src->rowSize`. This is the vulnerability that was fixed in commit 1c7c2bae (OSS-Fuzz 64471).
